entities.summary: Ariel Fernandez is an Argentinian–American physical chemist and pharmaceutical researcher. In 2025, a judge determined that Fernandez had engaged in scientific misconduct, and upheld a proposal that he be barred from receiving federal research funding in the US for 15 years, accusations that Fernandez denies.

entities.name: Ariel Fernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ariel Fernandez is an Argentinian–American physical chemist and pharmaceutical researcher. In 2025, a judge determined that Fernandez had engaged in scientific misconduct, and upheld a proposal that he be barred from receiving federal research funding in the US for 15 years, accusations that Fernandez denies.
